```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load the Data

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

# read in my data
data <- read_excel("activityAndSleep.xlsx", skip = 2, n_max = 18)

# give the columns shorter names
names(data) <- c("Date", "Exercise", "Move", "TotalCal", "Stand",
                 "Intervals", "Sleep", "SleepScore", "Wakeups", "Awake")

# change sleep from a time into hours
hours <- as.numeric(format(data$Sleep, "%H"))
minutes <- as.numeric(format(data$Sleep, "%M"))
data$SleepHours <- hours + minutes / 60

# use short labels so dates fit under the bar charts
date_labels <- format(as.Date(data$Date), "%m/%d")
```

## Tables

```{r}
# activity table
data[, c("Date", "Exercise", "Move", "TotalCal", "Stand", "Intervals")]
```

```{r}
# sleep table
data[, c("Date", "SleepHours", "SleepScore", "Wakeups", "Awake")]
```

```{r}
# summary statistics
summary(data[, c("Exercise", "Move", "TotalCal", "Stand", "Intervals",
                 "SleepHours", "SleepScore", "Wakeups", "Awake")])
```

## Graphs

```{r}
old_par <- par(mar = c(7, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1, las = 2)
barplot(data$Exercise, names.arg = date_labels,
        cex.names = 0.8,
        col = "lightblue",
        main = "Exercise Minutes per Day",
        xlab = "Date", ylab = "Exercise (minutes)")
abline(h = 90, lty = 2)
par(old_par)
```

```{r}
old_par <- par(mar = c(7, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1, las = 2)
barplot(data$Move, names.arg = date_labels,
        cex.names = 0.8,
        col = "lightblue",
        main = "Move Calories per Day",
        xlab = "Date", ylab = "Active Calories")
abline(h = 1600, lty = 2)
par(old_par)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Date, y = SleepHours)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Hours of Sleep per Night",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Sleep (hours)"
  )
```



```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Date, y = Intervals)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Active 15-Minute Intervals per Day",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Active Intervals"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Exercise, y = SleepHours)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Exercise vs Sleep",
    x = "Exercise (minutes)",
    y = "Sleep (hours)"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = SleepHours, y = SleepScore)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Sleep Hours vs Sleep Score",
    x = "Sleep (hours)",
    y = "Sleep Score"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Intervals, y = SleepHours)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Active Intervals vs. Sleep Hours",
    x = "Active 15-Minute Intervals",
    y = "Sleep (hours)"
  )
```
